name: Word Drill
description: A quick round of words you already have: the English, the word back, the next one. Nothing new is taught.

runtime_inputs.name: What to drill
runtime_inputs.prompt: What would you like to be drilled on?

objectives.description: Say each word from its English, one word at a time.
success_indicators: produces the word when given only the English
no part of the word was supplied first

teaching_philosophy: Only words the student already has. Nothing is taught.
English in, one word back, the next one. No sentences.
Every word once before any comes round again; a miss comes round once more at the end.

scenarios.name: Words already on file
scenarios.description: Saved words, and words taught earlier on the call, that fit what the student asked to be drilled on.

phases.name: Drill
phases.purpose: Every word once, from its English.
instructions: Ask for each word by its English only: one word in, one word back.

activities.name: Quick round
activities.description: The English, the word back, the next one.

advancement_guidance: Every word has been asked once, and each miss once more.
completion_guidance: Say how many were right first time, and which to look at again.

if_struggling: A miss is told plainly and comes round once more at the end of the round.
A word missed twice is let go for this call, and named at the end.
Offer to learn the words instead if too few come back.
if_succeeding: Offer a drill on another subject they have words for.
Offer a Vocabulary Builder lesson on something new.

basis: how many words were right first time
progress.notes: Approximate. Never state a percentage to the student.

criteria: every word in the drill has been asked
announcement_guidance: Say how many were right first time and name the misses. Then ask: again, or something else?

observe: which words came back unaided and which were missed
memory.notes: A drill teaches nothing new. Do not add its words as new vocabulary.
